output:
- User collects vintage camera equipment and postcards; began collecting again recently.
- On 2023/08/11 asked about space-saving displays, cataloging, and online collector communities.
- Added 17 new postcards since restarting; wants to track them in a catalog.
- Uses ID scheme PC001, PC002... (e.g., PC001 = 1920s Paris postcard from local antique shop, excellent condition; PC002 = 1950s beach scene, Colourpicture Publishers, eBay; PC003 = 1960s Eiffel Tower at Night, used with crease).
- Acquisition sources mentioned: local antique shop and eBay.
- Cataloging fields used: title, date, publisher, condition, acquisition date/source, unique ID.
- Expressed feeling overwhelmed by organizing; received advice on spreadsheets, archival storage, forums (Reddit r/VintageCameras, Facebook groups, Rangefinder Forum).
- Plans to check out the suggested online communities.
